# UNIVERSAL ULTRA-REALISTIC CHARACTER SHEET MASTER PROMPT
## 16K ULTRA-HD • STRICT IDENTITY LOCK • CHARACTER CONSISTENCY • UNIVERSAL GREY BACKGROUND

**REFERENCE IMAGE — PRIMARY AND AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE**

Use the uploaded photograph as the primary and authoritative reference for the character's identity and appearance. Create an ultra-photorealistic, premium-quality multi-panel character reference sheet suitable for professional AI filmmaking, cinematic storytelling, animation, character development, and image-to-video or text-to-video production.

The result must resemble a professional photographic character reference board, with realistic skin, authentic materials, precise anatomy, consistent identity, and a uniform grey studio background throughout.

## 1. ABSOLUTE IDENTITY PRESERVATION LOCK

Preserve the exact identity of the person shown in the uploaded reference image.

- Maintain the original facial structure, face shape, forehead, eyebrows, eye shape, eye spacing, nose, lips, jawline, cheekbones, ears, and chin.
- Preserve the original skin tone, natural skin characteristics, apparent age, gender, and recognizable facial identity.
- Maintain the exact hairstyle, hairline, hair color, hair length, texture, braids, curls, shaved patterns, and distinctive hair details.
- Preserve visible tattoos, scars, freckles, moles, piercings, facial hair, jewelry, and other identifying features.
- Maintain the same body type, height impression, shoulder width, limb proportions, and overall silhouette.
- Reproduce the original clothing, colors, materials, accessories, belts, watches, necklaces, and footwear wherever visible.
- Do not beautify, redesign, stylize, age-shift, or reinterpret the person's identity.
- Never substitute a different or merely similar-looking person.

**IDENTITY RULE:** Every panel must show the same individual. Only the viewing angle, framing, or requested facial expression may change.

## 2. STRICT CHARACTER CONSISTENCY LOCK

This section applies to every panel of the character sheet and every future scene generated using the approved character reference.

**Face consistency**
- Identical facial geometry, eye spacing, nose proportions, lips, jawline, and distinctive facial asymmetry.
- Identical hairline, hairstyle, hair color, facial hair, and identifying marks.
- No facial redesign between front, side, back, three-quarter, and close-up views.

**Body consistency**
- Consistent body proportions, build, shoulder width, limb length, and apparent height.
- Natural, anatomically correct posture and consistent physical characteristics.

**Wardrobe consistency**
- Identical outfit design, garment colors, fabric materials, stitching, pockets, buttons, belts, jewelry, watches, and footwear.
- No unexplained clothing changes, missing accessories, or invented design details.
- Back and side views must accurately correspond to the same outfit shown in the front view.

**Appearance consistency**
- Preserve skin tone, eye color when discernible, tattoos, scars, freckles, and other identifying features.
- Maintain consistent photographic realism, color treatment, and natural material appearance.

**REFERENCE HIERARCHY:** The uploaded photograph determines the person's identity. The generated character sheet establishes the visual reference for future production. In subsequent scenes, preserve the approved identity and appearance while changing only the requested pose, expression, environment, camera angle, lighting, or action.

## 3. UNIVERSAL GREY STUDIO BACKGROUND LOCK

**MANDATORY RULE: Every panel must use the same neutral grey studio background, regardless of the character's gender, age, appearance, hairstyle, skin tone, or wardrobe.**

- Use a clean, seamless, matte medium-grey photographic studio backdrop.
- Maintain the same grey color, tone, brightness, and visual appearance across all panels.
- Allow only a very subtle, natural tonal gradient from studio illumination.
- Use soft, realistic contact shadows beneath the feet in full-body views.
- Use subtle, natural shadows around the face and body without introducing background distractions.
- Maintain consistent background exposure, white balance, and lighting direction across the entire sheet.
- Keep the character clearly separated from the background through realistic edge definition and subtle studio rim lighting.
- Do not change the background color to match the character's clothing or skin tone.
- Do not introduce colored backdrops, outdoor scenery, room interiors, furniture, props, scenery, patterns, or environmental elements.
- Do not use a different background for portrait panels or detail panels.

**UNIVERSAL BACKGROUND RULE:** The character may be any person, but the background must always remain neutral grey in every single panel. Character appearance changes according to the uploaded reference; background color does not.

## 4. PROFESSIONAL MULTI-PANEL CHARACTER SHEET LAYOUT

Create one cohesive, precisely organized character reference sheet with thin, clean dividing lines, consistent spacing, and clearly separated photographic panels.

**PANEL 1 — FRONT FULL-BODY VIEW**

Show the character standing upright and facing the camera in a relaxed neutral pose. Display the complete outfit from head to toe, including hairstyle, accessories, hands, and footwear.

**PANEL 2 — BACK FULL-BODY VIEW**

Show the exact same character from directly behind. Accurately reproduce the hairstyle, clothing construction, seams, back pockets, accessories, and footwear.

**PANEL 3 — SIDE PROFILE VIEW**

Show the character in a complete side profile. Preserve the exact facial profile, nose shape, jawline, hairstyle, body proportions, and clothing silhouette.

**PANEL 4 — THREE-QUARTER FULL-BODY VIEW**

Show the character from a natural three-quarter angle. Maintain the same identity, proportions, outfit, and accessories.

**PANEL 5 — EXTREME FACE DETAIL**

Create a highly detailed facial portrait showing natural skin pores, fine facial hair, individual eyelashes, realistic eyes, eyebrow strands, subtle skin imperfections, and precise facial structure.

**PANEL 6 — FACIAL EXPRESSION VARIATIONS**

Include three close-up portraits of the same character with subtle expressions: neutral, thoughtful, and serious. Expressions may change naturally, but facial identity, bone structure, hairstyle, and identifying features must remain consistent.

**PANEL 7 — HAIRSTYLE AND IDENTIFYING FEATURES**

Show detailed close-ups of the hairstyle, hairline, braids, tattoos, scars, facial hair, piercings, or other distinguishing characteristics visible in the reference image.

**PANEL 8 — COSTUME AND ACCESSORY DETAILS**

Include close-up photographic panels of relevant fabric textures, stitching, buttons, jewelry, watches, belts, pockets, and footwear. Every detail must match the same outfit shown in the full-body panels.

**PANEL CONSISTENCY RULE:** All eight panel categories must depict the same character against the same neutral grey studio background, with no environmental changes.

## 5. ULTRA-PHOTOREALISTIC SKIN, HAIR AND MATERIAL DETAILS

Create the visual quality of premium professional fashion photography combined with high-end cinematic production photography.

**Natural skin**
- Realistic pores, fine skin texture, subtle tonal variations, and authentic imperfections.
- Physically believable subsurface light scattering and natural skin highlights.
- Realistic lips, eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows, and facial hair.
- No waxy, glossy, overly airbrushed, or plastic-looking skin.

**Realistic hair**
- Individually defined strands and natural hair density.
- Realistic flyaway hairs, hairline details, braids, curls, and natural shadows.
- Accurate hair texture and consistent hairstyle from every angle.

**Realistic clothing and materials**
- Clearly defined fabric weave, stitching, seams, folds, and garment tension.
- Realistic leather grain, metal reflections, jewelry, watch glass, buttons, and footwear textures.
- Physically believable reflections, highlights, shadows, and material responses.

**Detail quality:** Prioritize genuine photographic realism, fine texture, natural anatomy, crisp edges, clean tonal transitions, and realistic material detail without artificial oversharpening.

## 6. LIGHTING AND PROFESSIONAL STUDIO PHOTOGRAPHY

Use a controlled professional studio lighting setup suitable for a neutral grey backdrop.

- Large diffused key light for natural facial definition.
- Soft fill light to retain details in dark clothing and shadow areas.
- Subtle rim lighting to separate the character from the grey background.
- Natural contact shadows beneath the feet and believable shadows around the body.
- Accurate skin tones, balanced exposure, controlled highlights, and detailed shadow areas.
- Consistent white balance, contrast, light direction, and color grading across every panel.

Avoid harsh artificial sharpening, excessive HDR, overexposure, crushed shadows, oversaturated colors, inconsistent lighting, and unnatural skin reflections.

## 7. CAMERA, FRAMING AND PANEL ACCURACY

- Use realistic professional photographic perspective.
- Keep full-body views at consistent camera height, scale, and perspective.
- Use natural portrait framing for close-ups without distorting facial proportions.
- Keep every panel precisely aligned with clean, thin dividing lines.
- Show the entire character in all full-body views, including the head and footwear.
- Maintain sufficient spacing between panels.
- Avoid overlapping images, cut-off limbs, and cropped identifying details.
- Ensure the complete character sheet is clean, balanced, readable, and useful as a visual reference for subsequent image and video generation.
- Preserve realistic anatomy and proportions in every view.

## 8. MAXIMUM PHOTOREALISM AND IMAGE QUALITY LOCK

Generate the highest-quality photographic image supported by the image-generation tool.

Prioritize:
- Exceptional facial clarity and identity accuracy.
- Fine skin pores, hair strands, and fabric textures.
- Crisp edges and detailed accessories.
- Accurate anatomy and natural proportions.
- Realistic lighting, shadows, reflections, and material surfaces.
- Clean panel boundaries and consistent grey backgrounds.
- Smooth tonal transitions and professional cinematic color grading.

Avoid pixelation, compression artifacts, repeated artificial textures, jagged edges, blurry faces, oversharpening halos, color banding, excessive noise, and loss of fine detail.

## 9. RESOLUTION LOCK — 16K ULTRA-HD

**RESOLUTION LOCK:** Generate the final image in **16K resolution — 15360 × 8640 pixels (≈132.7 million pixels), 16:9 aspect ratio**. Preserve maximum possible detail, sharpness, texture, fine edges, realistic skin and material details, with no cropping, stretching, compression, pixelation, or loss of quality. Maintain the exact composition and framing of the reference image while rendering at true 16K quality.

- The complete character sheet must use a 16:9 canvas.
- Arrange all panels intelligently within the canvas so every view remains visible and correctly proportioned.
- Do not stretch individual panels or distort the character to fill the frame.
- Prioritize the highest available native resolution.
- If the image-generation tool cannot directly produce 15360 × 8640 pixels, generate at the highest supported resolution and use a high-quality upscaling workflow to reach the specified dimensions.
- Upscaling must preserve the original facial identity, anatomy, clothing, and panel composition without introducing inconsistent features.

**QUALITY PRIORITY:** High-resolution detail must never come at the expense of identity preservation, natural anatomy, or character consistency.

## 10. STRICT NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

No identity drift, no face swapping, no different faces between panels, no inconsistent hairstyle, no changing tattoos, no inconsistent wardrobe, no altered body proportions, no duplicate facial features, no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no malformed hands, no distorted anatomy, no unnatural joints, no missing accessories, no floating objects, no blurry facial details, no plastic skin, no cartoon appearance, no painterly rendering, no artificial 3D-model appearance, no colored backgrounds, no outdoor scenery, no room interiors, no inconsistent grey tones, no overlapping panels, no cropped full-body views, no random text, no watermark.

## 11. FINAL MASTER INSTRUCTION

Create a single, ultra-realistic, premium-quality 16:9 character reference sheet that establishes the definitive visual identity of the person in the uploaded photograph.

Every panel must represent the same individual from a different viewing angle, expression, or detail view. Preserve exact identity, facial geometry, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, accessories, and distinctive features.

**The background must remain the same neutral medium-grey studio backdrop in every panel, regardless of which character is uploaded.**

The finished sheet must be suitable for reuse as the master visual reference for future AI-generated images, storyboards, cinematic scenes, and image-to-video or text-to-video productions.

### FINAL PRIORITY ORDER

1. Exact identity preservation.
2. Strict character consistency across all panels.
3. Identical neutral grey studio background throughout.
4. Accurate facial anatomy and natural skin texture.
5. Consistent hairstyle, wardrobe, accessories, and body proportions.
6. Complete, clean, professionally organized character-sheet composition.
7. Maximum available resolution and photorealistic detail.
